import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a comprehensive visualization with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival Rate by Class
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
survival_by_class['rate'] = survival_by_class['sum'] / survival_by_class['count']
class_order = ['First', 'Second', 'Third']
survival_by_class = survival_by_class.reindex(class_order)
bars = ax1.bar(survival_by_class.index, survival_by_class['rate'], color=['#2ecc71', '#3498db', '#e74c3c'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.1%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 2. Survival Rate by Sex
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
survival_by_sex['rate'] = survival_by_sex['sum'] / survival_by_sex['count']
bars = ax2.bar(survival_by_sex.index, survival_by_sex['rate'], color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.1%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 3. Age Distribution by Survival
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax3.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax3.legend()

# 4. Survival by Class and Sex
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
survival_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_class_sex = survival_class_sex.reindex(class_order)
survival_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#e74c3c', '#3498db'], rot=0)
ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax4.legend(title='Gender', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
ax4.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 5. Fare Distribution by Survival
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
survived_fare = df[df['survived'] == 1]['fare'].dropna()
died_fare = df[df['survived'] == 0]['fare'].dropna()
ax5.boxplot([died_fare, survived_fare], labels=['Died', 'Survived'],
            patch_artist=True, 
            boxprops=dict(facecolor='#3498db', alpha=0.7),
            medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2))
ax5.set_title('Fare Distribution by Survival', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Fare (£)')
ax5.set_ylim(0, 300)

# 6. Survival Rate by Embarkation Port
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_survival = embark_survival.dropna()
colors = ['#9b59b6', '#f39c12', '#1abc9c']
bars = ax6.bar(embark_survival.index, embark_survival['rate'], color=colors)
ax6.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Port (C=Cherbourg, Q=Queenstown, S=Southampton)')
ax6.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax6.set_ylim(0, 1)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.1%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
